## Propagate this brief into the 3 context files

`/pds` STEP 1 writes the context files from the answers above. This is the mapping — use it, do
not invent a structure.

| Brief section | Goes to | Under |
|---|---|---|
| §1 Product overview | `agent-system/context/client_vision.md` | `## Product Goals` |
| §2 Target users (personas + JTBDs) | `agent-system/context/client_vision.md` | `## Target Users & JTBDs` |
| §2 Values + UX anti-patterns | `agent-system/context/client_vision.md` | `## Product Values` |
| §4 Success metrics | `agent-system/context/client_vision.md` | `## Key Success Metrics` |
| §3 Core features, prioritised | `agent-system/context/roadmap.md` | `## Feature Backlog` |
| §3 Current phase | `agent-system/context/roadmap.md` | `## Current Focus` |
| §4 KPI baselines | `agent-system/context/roadmap.md` | `## KPI Baselines` |
| §5 Out of scope | `agent-system/context/roadmap.md` | `## Out of Scope` |
| Visual direction + 3 aesthetic words | `agent-system/context/design_guide.md` | `## Design Tokens` |
| UX anti-patterns (visual side) | `agent-system/context/design_guide.md` | `## Anti-Patterns` |
| Detected from the repo (1c) | `agent-system/context/design_guide.md` | `## Design Tokens` · `## Component Usage` |
